script.cover_1: Asking a junior if they are serious about the job can backfire.
script.payoff: It makes the junior perform loyalty instead of improving the work.
script.caption: A question that tests loyalty gets effort that looks like loyalty. Send this to the manager who asks it in reviews.
script.sent: Are you serious about this job?
script.lands: The junior may feel judged, then work late just to look present.
script.better: Let us talk about the planning work. What would help you own it?
script.why: It asks for one clear change and offers a talk, not a loyalty test.
